Name: American Martyrs Church
Description: This is the church my family attends when I am home. It is also the parish where I grew up and went to school from preschool through eighth grade, making it a place full of memories.

Name: Boccato’s
Description: Boccato’s is a neighborhood grocery and sandwich shop that my family visits often. It is a favorite stop before a beach day, and we always enjoy chatting with the owners.

Name: Paradise Bowls
Description: Paradise Bowls is my go-to local acai shop. It is the perfect refreshing snack on a hot beach day, and I always make sure to stop here when I am home.

Name: Manhattan Beach Pier
Address: 2 Manhattan Beach Blvd, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
Description: The Manhattan Beach Pier is one of the most iconic spots in the area. I often come here for walks and to enjoy the ocean views, especially during sunset.

Name: Manhattan Village Mall
Address: 3200 N Sepulveda Blvd, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
Description: Manhattan Village is the main shopping area near my hometown. It was recently renovated and now has great stores, restaurants, and a lively atmosphere.

Name: Unlimited Fitness
Description: Unlimited Fitness is the gym I go to whenever I am home from school. It is a locally owned gym with a strong community feel, and I work out here almost every day when visiting.

Name: Hermosa Beach Pier
Description: The Hermosa Beach Pier is another favorite place to walk along the ocean and enjoy the beach atmosphere. It is always lively and a great place to spend time outside.

Name: Gitana Cafe
Description: Gitana Cafe is one of my favorite local coffee spots near the beach. It has a relaxed atmosphere and great coffee flavors, making it a perfect morning stop.

Name: El Sombrero
Description: El Sombrero is a classic Mexican restaurant in Manhattan Beach. The owner always greets guests with “Welcome home,” which makes the place feel especially welcoming.

Name: Brewco
Address: 124 Manhattan Beach Blvd, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
Description: Brewco is a fun spot for dinner, appetizers, or drinks with friends. It is located near many shops and dessert places, making it a great place to spend an evening.
